recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not remove QuestionnaireResponse.item.answer.item unless a future work-group decision explicitly changes the nesting model.
issue_request: FHIR-20768 asked to remove QuestionnaireResponse.item.answer.item as superfluous. The published resolution rejected removal and required clearer guidance on using item.item for nesting within groups and item.answer.item for nesting under each answer to a question.
initial_application: Git 883645bf2e05bb98f5cf1581aaa6e21f84591ca5 explicitly applied FHIR-20768 by adding comments to QuestionnaireResponse.item.answer.item and QuestionnaireResponse.item.item. Later same-family commits added narrative guidance and refined the group-nesting sentence.
additional_context: QuestionnaireResponse is active in source/fhir.ini. Earlier and later final decisions, including FHIR-10481, FHIR-12071, FHIR-31357, and FHIR-38853, consistently preserve both recursion points and clarify their use. A 2024 Zulip thread also reiterates the repeating-answer use case for item.answer.item.
